description.value: The Glass Foundry is a working glassblowing studio and gallery on Salt Spring Island that recycles scrap glass into wholesale giftware while producing unique blown, cast, and fused art pieces. Visitors are welcome to watch glassmaking in progress and can participate in drop-in workshops or adult classes. The studio is set on a rural farming acreage just outside Ganges village, making it a distinctive craft destination for cyclists exploring the island.

address.value: 401 Upper Ganges Road, Salt Spring Island, V8K 1R7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Glass Foundry is an active glassblowing studio and gallery at 401 Upper Ganges Rd., Salt Spring Island, with phone 250-537-9200 matching OSM. The site makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities, so all those fields are null. The studio is noted to be on a rural farming acreage that is also the artist's home, which is worth flagging as a concern but does not preclude it from the directory.
concerns: The studio is located on a rural farming acreage that is also the home of the artist and family — verify that public visitor access is clearly demarcated and suitable for drop-in cycling visits.
Location is described as a 3-minute drive outside Ganges; the road and cycling suitability of the approach route are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, fee-free gallery and working studio open to visitors on a popular cycling island; a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists even though cyclist-specific amenities are unconfirmed.

wow_evidence: Working glassblowing studio, visitors watch production, drop-in workshops — watchable working studio ladder 1/2.
blurb: Working glassblowing studio near Ganges; watch the furnace or join a workshop.
